Maya (Product): Customer 'Orion' requested a formal SLA for chat latency: p95 <= 120ms on their real prompts. They want pilot in 5 weeks. Need a quick triage across runtime/infra/platform/security.

Ethan (Eng-Runtime): We can probably hit it with dedicated resources + aggressive KV prefetch. Current p95 for that model is ~128ms under similar loads. Ill look at kernel/parallelism tweaks but need infra support.

Priya (Infra): Recommend provisioning a small reserved fleet (3 GPUs pinned) and a prewarm hook. Will cost extra but will isolate perf. I can sketch provisioning timeline (48-72h to provision once approved).

Nina (Eng-Platform): Ill add route-level toggles and a console switch (prefetch=true, min_instances=3). Also can add an automated fallback to a latency-optimized model variant. Will open PR tomorrow.

Omar (Security): Need dedicated KMS key, retention policy doc, and verification that inference traces are sanitized of PII. I can do a quick compliance checklist.

Sam (PM): Orion will fund the reserved fleet for the pilot. Acceptance criteria: p95 <= 120ms on 10k samples of Orion prompts, error-rate delta <= 0.1%, signed KMS/retention doc, and rollback plan.

Maya (Product): Action items by EOD Thu: Ethan perf test plan; Priya provisioning + cost; Nina PR link; Omar compliance checklist; Sam confirm prompt delivery date. Ill assemble playbook after.

deploy-bot: Sync scheduled Mon 10:00am PT ":"
